opportunities.name: Movie research and movie-night email draft
opportunities.description: For a given movie, look up IMDb rating and Rotten Tomatoes score, then draft an email to a friend with the movie details.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open its page
Search the movie title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page
Open mail compose, enter recipient, subject 'Movie night <day>: <title>'
Type body with director, runtime, IMDb and Tomatometer scores

opportunities.name: npm package stats note
opportunities.description: For an npm package, look up its stats on npmjs and GitHub releases and save a summary note.
steps: Search the package name on npmjs
Open the package page, note version, weekly downloads, license
Open Releases and note stars, open issues, last release date
Open notes app and add a note with the summary
